markets.classification_rationale: neither series ticker 'KXNCAAF1HFT' nor contract text resolved to a known family; retained verbatim for external interpretation
markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire after a winner is declared.

fee.note: This is the documented TRADE FEE only (fee model, rounded up to $0.000001) -- NOT a net fee. Kalshi's net fee is trade fee + rounding fee - rebate, where the rounding fee, the rebate and the per-order fee accumulator all depend on the account's target balance precision ($0.0001 direct member, $0.01 non-direct) and on that order's fill sequence. fee.side_note: Buying YES executes at basis_yes_ask; buying NO executes at basis_no_ask. markets.rules_primary: If South Carolina wins the 1st half and South Carolina wins the full game in the Tennessee vs South Carolina college football game originally scheduled for Oct 24, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on the combination of the 1st half and full game (including overtime) result of the Tennessee vs South Carolina college football game originally scheduled for Oct 24, 2026. If either the first half or full game result is incorrect, the market resolves to No as both results have to be correct in order for the market to resolve Yes. If the game is postponed but begins within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start time, the market will remain open and resolve based on the official final result. If the game is not started within 48 hours, the market will resolve to a fair price.
